thread:
Anya: Heads-up: Customer Z asked for per-tenant encrypted prefetch and HSM-backed keys in private deployments. We need cross-team alignment on scope, owners, sequencing, and launch criteria. Can we do a quick plan here?

Devon: Short answer: yes, probably as a gated pilot. What's the minimum to ship safely?

Anya: Minimum: (a) HSM/KMS integration with tenant key binding, (b) runtime support for tenant-scoped encrypted KV prefixes, (c) infra capacity reservation + cost guardrails, (d) audit/logging + threat signoff.

Lee: Runtime note: adding encrypted prefixes is a small API change but cache migration needs care. We'll gate with an opt-in tenant flag and keep old behavior as default until migration completes.

Marcos: Infra: we can carve out dedicated prewarm slots for the pilot but need exact slot counts. Pricing impact rough estimate: +6-10% baseline for the pilot cohort depending on eviction settings.

Priya: Security: HSM onboarding and KMS policy review normally 10-14 business days. If customer requires specific vendor attestation it could add 2w. We also need an audit schema for key operations.

Alex: Product acceptance proposal: 1) <=10% relative regression on P95 inference latency; 2) per-tenant billing visibility for prewarm; 3) HSM key ops logged and auditable; 4) pilot with 3 tenants for 14 days with no severity-1 incidents.

Anya: Proposed schedule: Week0: final spec + signoffs; Week1-2: security vendor onboarding + infra reservation; Week2-3: runtime dev + internal canary; Week4: external pilot; Week6: review & GA decision. Risks: vendor procurement (+2-3w), cache eviction bug (+1-2w).

Devon: Who will own the spec and the rollout docs? Need single source of truth.

Anya: I'll draft the spec. Lee owns canary toggles; Marcos owns infra reservations and cost scenarios; Priya owns security signoff checklist; Alex owns acceptance tests.

Lee: Canary toggle example snippet: ```json
{"tenant": "tenant-xyz", "features": {"prefetch_encrypted": true}, "rollout": {"canary": true}}```

Marcos: We'll put a soft cost cap per-tenant during pilot. Suggest infra emits billing alerts at 120% of expected usage and auto-disables prewarm if unacknowledged.

Priya: Security checklist (short): vendor screening, KMS policy, HSM integration tests, audit schema, threat model signoff. I'll post doc by EOD with required artifacts.

Alex: Acceptance tests: include synthetic burst test and long-tail KV hit pattern. I'll add thresholds to the perf harness and wire up dashboards.

Anya: Fallback if HSM delayed: allow software KMS with explicit customer consent and labeling in contract + stricter SLA. Security OK with this path if documented.

Priya: Confirmed: soft KMS fallback acceptable with waiver and clear logging. We'll require a customer opt-in flow.

Devon: Triage plan for vendor delay: start runtime & infra work in parallel, run internal canary using software KMS, then flip to HSM once ready.

Lee: Migration plan: runtime will support prefix versioning (v1/v2). We'll run opt-in tenants on v2, then provide an automated migration tool to rehydrate caches.

Marcos: Action items: Marcos -> capacity estimate and cost scenarios by Thu; Priya -> security checklist + vendor note by EOD; Lee -> canary toggle prototype by Fri; Alex -> acceptance test scaffold by Wed; Anya -> spec draft by Tue.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance window Saturday 03:00 UTC. Feature-flag quota changes will be blocked during maintenance.

Anya: Noted. We'll plan PRs to avoid that window or adjust schedule.

Alex: I'll coordinate with SRE for dashboards: per-tenant prewarm billing, P95 latency lines, error rates, and key-op audit spikes.

Priya: Highest risk is vendor procurement. Recommend parallel engagement with vendor and legal to shorten onboarding.

Devon: No objections from engineering side. Keep acceptance tests strict. :thumbsup:

Lee: I'll add a risk page to the spec detailing rollback paths and automatic disable of prefetch on anomalies.

Anya: Final call: any objections?

Marcos: None. Will deliver numbers.

Priya: None. Will post checklist.

Alex: All good.

Anya: Thanks everyone — I'll post the spec link when ready and ping for signoffs.
